The class is an internal closed static-table dispatch, not an external ABI contract; its admission rests on the finite enumerated target set, not on a documented application obligation.
The target set is what the context's closed table set can hold; it does not assert that any particular member executes, nor the correctness of the selected function's body.

For `entry-table-pairing` sites the context-to-row fact rests on the documented OSSL_FUNC_CIPHER_NEWCTX/entry pairing; the row set and the row's installed table are read from the authoring macros, and the image must still resolve the resulting target set exactly.
Reachability of these targets from the two workloads is the closure's own result; this artifact does not re-measure it.
No compatibility or cryptographic assurance claim is made here.
